svg.aria-label: Price history against theme history at one scale
svg.text: Twenty years of prices. Four days of themes.
Both drawn to the same time scale.
Daily price bars — 2,402,296 rows, Jan 2006 to Sep 2026
Macro theme snapshots — 16 rows, four days
the whole theme record is this line
Prices can be replayed backward. Themes cannot — nobody was recording them.
